title: Copy the current footprint into a new PcbLib
summary: Clones the footprint shown in the active PCB library with all its primitives and registers the copy, under a new name, in a newly created and saved PcbLib. Shows how to move a footprint between libraries.
phrasings: duplicate a footprint into another library
create a new PcbLib from code
register a footprint in a PCB library

commands.name: CopyCurrentLibComponent
commands.description: Copy the current footprint into a new PCB library
commands.params: Name=<footprint name> (default TestComp)|Out=<folder or .PcbLib path> (default: temp folder, file CopyPcbLibComponent.PcbLib)|Overwrite=true (replace an existing Out file)
